newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed in thin market.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed in thin market.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday with gas oil and gasoline easing with IPE futures while high sulphur fuel oil extended Monday's gains, traders said.
Heating oil barges fell with the Nov IPE gas oil contract, which was down $2.75 at $224.25 a tonne at 1045 GMT. Prompt premiums were put at Nov IPE +50 cents/+$1 a tonne, fob ARA.
High sulphur barges extended gains seen on Monday. Traders reported deals at $121 and $122.
Eurograde barges were put at $227/$229 a tonne fob ARA. Traders said the market was very thin.
